mechanism: Moxifloxacin may inhibit phenytoin metabolism via CYP3A4/CYP2C9, potentially increasing phenytoin levels, while phenytoin induces fluoroquinolone metabolism reducing moxifloxacin efficacy.
action: Monitor phenytoin serum levels and clinical signs of toxicity; consider alternative fluoroquinolone or increased moxifloxacin dosing; assess for ataxia, nystagmus, and sedation.
